info.title: WACS CLI
info.description: WACS unified WebAssembly toolchain: run, build, aot, inspect, bindgen. v1.3 picks up WACS.Transpiler.Lib v0.7's PersistedAssemblyBuilder migration + RVA-mapped data segments, so `wacs build` produces ~11% smaller .dlls and the new EmissionTarget.Auto default cuts cold start by ~50% on the common module shapes. The `wacs aot` verb produces self-contained NativeAOT native binaries from a wasm input in one shot, with --wasi / --wasip2 baking in WASI Preview 1 / Preview 2 hosts. Supersedes wasm-transpile (WACS.Transpiler).

commands.name: run
commands.description: Execute a .wasm module via the interpreter (default) or transpiler engine. Default verb when the first arg is a file path.

options.name: --no-validate
options.description: Skip module validation after parsing. By default the validator surfaces malformed-module errors with .wat renders of the offending function bodies.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print parser timing, instantiation diagnostics, and a transpilation summary when applicable.

options.name: --call
options.description: Function export to invoke (default: _start, then any configured WASM start section). Pass arguments after `--` for the function or for WASI argv.

options.name: --engine
options.description: Execution engine: interpreter (default) or transpiler. transpiler JITs to .NET IL via Reflection.Emit and runs through CLR-native dispatch with imports proxied back to the interpreter for mixed-mode execution. [default: interpreter]

options.name: --module
options.description: Name to register the instantiated module under for cross-module import resolution. Defaults to `_` for single-module runs; multi-input runs use the file basename per input. [default: _]

options.name: --env
options.description: Environment variables for WASI Preview 1 (KEY=VALUE), comma-separated.

options.name: --dir
options.description: Pre-opened directories for WASI Preview 1, comma-separated.

options.name: --wasi
options.description: Bind WASI Preview 1 host imports before execution. Equivalent to `--bind <Wacs.WASI.Preview1>`.

options.name: --host-package
options.description: Host package assembly name(s) or path(s) whose [WitSource]-tagged interfaces resolve a component's imports at transpile time. Component-mode only.

options.name: --wasip2
options.description: Shorthand for `--host-package Wacs.WASI.Preview2`. Component-mode only.

options.name: --bind
options.description: Path(s) to assemblies containing IBindable host libraries to wire into the runtime before execution.

options.name: --profile
options.description: Bracket execution with a JetBrains dotTrace measure-profiling session. Snapshot lands in the OS-default profiler temp dir.

options.name: --log-gas
options.description: Print total instructions executed after the run.

options.name: --gas-limit
options.description: Limit dispatched instructions; raises a TrapException when exceeded. 0 = unlimited. [default: 0]

options.name: --log-progress
options.description: Print '.' every N instructions. -1 = disabled. [default: -1]

options.name: --log-execution
options.description: Log per-instruction execution: None | Computes | Calls | Branches | Memory | All. [default: 0]

options.name: --calculate-lines
options.description: Calculate line numbers for instruction-execution logs. Adds a per-call lookup over the parsed module.

options.name: --stats
options.description: Collect per-instruction statistics: None | Total | Instruction | Function. [default: 0]

options.name: --super
options.description: Enable super-instruction fusion. With --switch, fuses the bytecode stream; otherwise rewrites the polymorphic instruction tree.

options.name: --switch
options.description: Use the source-generated monolithic switch runtime (faster, AOT-safe).

options.name: --simd
options.description: SIMD strategy for --engine transpiler: interpreter | scalar | intrinsics. [default: scalar]

options.name: --no-tail-calls
options.description: Disable CIL `tail.` prefix for return_call* ops (--engine transpiler only).

options.name: --max-fn-size
options.description: Skip transpilation of functions larger than N instructions (--engine transpiler only). 0 = unlimited. [default: 0]

options.name: --data-storage
options.description: Data segment storage for --engine transpiler: compressed | raw | static. [default: compressed]

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

arguments.name: FILES
arguments.description: Path(s) to .wasm / .wat / .component.wasm input file(s). Multiple inputs trigger ModuleLinker composition; cross-module imports resolve via filename basenames. Trailing args after `--` are forwarded to the guest's argv / --call function.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Transpile a .wasm module to a .NET assembly (.dll). Multi-input runs land siblings as <basename>.dll alongside the chosen --output path.

options.name: --no-validate
options.description: Skip module validation after parsing. By default the validator surfaces malformed-module errors with .wat renders of the offending function bodies.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print parser timing, instantiation diagnostics, and a transpilation summary when applicable.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output .dll path. Omit (or pass a directory) to default to <inputBasename>.dll alongside the input. With multiple inputs, this is the path for the LAST input; siblings land at <basename>.dll alongside.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Root namespace for the generated types. [default: CompiledWasm]

options.name: --module
options.description: Name of the generated Module class. [default: WasmModule]

options.name: --assembly-name
options.description: Override the generated assembly's logical name. When set, skips the default `<namespace>.<module>_<uniqueId>` scheme. Required for the wacs-aot whole-program build path so ILC's resolver can find the .dll via static <Reference>; the on-disk filename should also be <assemblyname>.dll.

options.name: --emission
options.description: Module ctor emission shape: standard (codec-encoded init data, works for in-process and cross-process load) or aot-linked (direct ThinContext construction, no codec wrapper, dead-strippable from a NativeAOT consumer's binary). aot-linked currently supports compute-only modules; coverage will grow. [default: standard]

options.name: --wasi
options.description: Bake WASI Preview 1 bindings into the output assembly.

options.name: --bind
options.description: Path(s) to assemblies containing IBindable host libraries to wire into the build runtime.

options.name: --host-package
options.description: Host package assembly name(s) or path(s) whose [WitSource]-tagged interfaces resolve component imports at transpile time. Component-mode only.

options.name: --wasip2
options.description: Shorthand for `--host-package Wacs.WASI.Preview2`. Component-mode only.

options.name: --emit-main
options.description: Bake a Program.Main(string[]) into the output assembly so it runs as an executable host for the transpiled module. Core-mode requires zero-import modules; component-mode handles imports through the configured host package.

options.name: --entry-point
options.description: When --emit-main is set, the WASM export Main invokes. [default: _start]

options.name: --main-class
options.description: When --emit-main is set, the name of the emitted Program class. [default: Program]

options.name: --simd
options.description: SIMD strategy: interpreter | scalar | intrinsics. [default: scalar]

options.name: --no-tail-calls
options.description: Disable CIL `tail.` prefix for return_call* ops.

options.name: --max-fn-size
options.description: Skip transpilation of functions larger than N instructions. 0 = unlimited. [default: 0]

options.name: --data-storage
options.description: Data segment storage: compressed | raw | static. [default: compressed]

options.name: --gc-checking
options.description: Comma-separated TranspilerCapabilities flags enabling additional GC type-check layers.

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

arguments.name: FILES
arguments.description: Path(s) to .wasm / .component.wasm input file(s). Multi-file → ModuleLinker composition; component-mode auto-detects via the layer header byte.

commands.name: aot
commands.description: Produce a self-contained NativeAOT native binary from a wasm input. End-to-end transpile + scaffold + publish. MVP supports compute-only modules; coverage will grow.

options.name: --output
options.description: Path for the produced native binary. Defaults to <inputBasename> in the current directory (no .exe extension by default — set explicitly on Windows).

options.name: --rid
options.description: Target .NET runtime identifier (e.g. osx-arm64, linux-x64, win-x64). Defaults to the host's RID.

options.name: --entry-point
options.description: WASM export the emitted Program.Main invokes. Scalar args only (i32/i64/f32/f64). [default: _start]

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Root namespace for generated types in the transpiled .dll. [default: WacsAot]

options.name: --simd
options.description: SIMD strategy: interpreter | scalar | intrinsics. [default: scalar]

options.name: --keep-temp
options.description: Don't delete the temporary build directory. Useful for inspecting the scaffolded csproj / Program.cs.

options.name: --aot-linked
options.description: Use the AotLinked transpiler emission target (skip the codec wrapper for ~50 KB binary-size reduction). Currently only supports compute-only modules — fails on modules declaring memory, tables, globals, or data segments. Default emission (Standard) covers all wasms but keeps the codec wrapper.

options.name: --wasi
options.description: Bake WASI Preview 1 bindings into the produced binary. The scaffolded consumer references WACS.WASI.Preview1 + WACS.HostBindings.SourceGen + WACS.HostBindings.Abstractions; the source generator emits an IImports adapter that wires the wasm's wasi_snapshot_preview1.* imports to the annotated bindings in WACS.WASI.Preview1. Trailing positional args become the wasm's argv.

options.name: --wasip2
options.description: Component-mode counterpart to --wasi. The input must be a WebAssembly Component (header byte = 0x02). The transpiler direct-links wasi:* imports against WACS.WASI.Preview2's typed C# host interfaces at build time; the scaffolded consumer references WACS.WASI.Preview2 + WACS.WASI.Preview2.DependencyInjection and constructs the WasiPreview2Bundle via Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection before invoking the named export.

options.name: --preopen
options.description: WASI directory preopens, one per --preopen, formatted as <host-path>::<guest-path>. Repeat or comma-separate for multiple. Only meaningful with --wasi.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print each step (transpile, scaffold, publish, copy).

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

arguments.name: ARGS
arguments.description: Trailing positional args forwarded to the wasm guest (e.g. as argv when --wasi is set).

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Diagnostics: parse a .wasm and dump WAT / stats / exports.

options.name: --no-validate
options.description: Skip module validation after parsing. By default the validator surfaces malformed-module errors with .wat renders of the offending function bodies.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print parser timing, instantiation diagnostics, and a transpilation summary when applicable.

options.name: --dump-wat
options.description: Render parser-friendly WAT to stdout (or to <basename>.wat with --output-dir). Round-trips back through the text parser.

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: When --dump-wat is set, write the .wat file into this directory instead of stdout.

options.name: --stats
options.description: Print a summary table: function count, import / export counts, memory pages, table sizes, data segment bytes, parsed-section sizes.

options.name: --exports
options.description: List the module's exports (name, kind, type).

options.name: --imports
options.description: List the module's imports (module, name, kind, type).

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

commands.name: bindgen
commands.description: Generate C# bindings from WIT (forward) or regenerate WIT + bindings from a transpiled .dll (reverse). Inputs are positional: .wit / a WIT directory / a .dll.

options.name: --no-validate
options.description: Skip module validation after parsing. By default the validator surfaces malformed-module errors with .wat renders of the offending function bodies.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print parser timing, instantiation diagnostics, and a transpilation summary when applicable.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory. One C# file per emitted interface / world / package.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Root C# namespace for generated bindings. Defaults to the WIT package's qualified name (Phase 1d uses the pinned wit-bindgen-csharp convention; explicit override is a follow-up).

options.name: --write-wit
options.description: Reverse mode only. Also write the raw extracted component-type bytes alongside the .cs files (useful for `wasm-tools component wit` round-trip inspection).

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description: Input path: a single .wit file, a directory tree of .wit files (recurses into deps/), or a transpiled .dll for the reverse direction.
